text: A laboratory interior, slightly blurred. Overhead fluorescent tube fixtures run across the white ceiling; a small dome light sits at upper left. Centre frame: a tall vertical aluminium column/post on a rail, with a black cable looping down from a dark housing at its top. In front, a black rectangular panel with two light rectangular windows, mounted on a bench. Left of centre, a computer monitor displaying a blue-white screen, with a black box beside it and a metal rack of small fittings. Foreground: white and grey aluminium extrusion profiles and clamps. Right side: a white cabinet holding a red-capped orange/red bottle and a smaller red container; a clear funnel and blue-topped items above. A pegboard with hanging tools and coloured handles hangs on the right wall, beside a white countertop.
